elements.description: Our aim is simple: utter annihilation of the enemy. Kill them all. [Completing this objective will cause all Germans at the warzone to retreat, and transfer the warzone plus any enemy infastructure to your control.]

The enemy has taken up position here - here, in our homes and our streets. Drive them out and reclaim this city. [Completing this objective will transfer the warzone and all enemy infrastructure here to your control.]
